2115487522247831672.en_summary: Lululemon $LULU hit an all time high at the end of 2023, up more than 700% over the prior ten years. Nearly three years later, shares are down 80% from highs and back to May 2018 levels. Questions where it will be ten years from now.
2115487522247831672.zh_summary: Lululemon $LULU 於 2023 年底創下歷史新高，過去十年漲幅超過 700%。近三年後，股價從高點下跌 80%，回到 2018 年 5 月水平。提問十年後將會如何。

2115482385328615701.en_summary: Investment question. Which will outperform over the next five years? Buying the common shares in a memory chip manufacturer like Micron $MU at today’s 12% current earnings yield (8.3x P/E) and 17.8% expected FY 2027 earnings yield (5.6x P/E) or buying Micron’s 3.477% 11/01/51 debt yielding 6.24%?
2115482385328615701.zh_summary: 投資問題。未來五年哪項表現更佳？以當前 12% 盈利收益率（8.3 倍市盈率）及預期 2027 財年 17.8% 盈利收益率（5.6 倍市盈率）買入記憶體晶片製造商美光 $MU 普通股，還是買入其 3.477% 的 2051 年 11 月 1 日到期債券（收益率 6.24%）。
